generation.scope: A general marked window of the fifteen-dimensional fully asymmetric component gives a completely general 4 by 4 by 4 tensor, with finitely many marked completions up to basis. On its determinantal quartic K3, two pencils in genus-eleven polarizations cut out the same length-twenty scheme. One pencil recovers the window; a rank-six condition on an eight by sixteen cohomology map recovers the other pencil when the Picard lattice is minimal.

open_mathematics: Use the linked pencils on the determinantal K3 to control the regularity and exceptional completions of asymmetric cuts. Determine the missing cubic sections and the precise overlap and obstruction at each pencil.
